UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile storing institution (schoolId), role preference, and active classroom binding.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

schoolId.description: Normalized uppercase School Code / Tenant ID (e.g., DPS_BALLABGARH), or empty before onboarding.

activeClassroomId.description: Currently selected classroom document ID within the user's school, or empty string.

activeRole.description: Active role mode selected by the user.

School.title: School
School.description: Institution / tenant root document isolating classrooms, rosters, invites, and attendance sessions.

schoolId.description: Canonical uppercase School Code / Tenant ID (e.g., DPS_BALLABGARH).

name.description: Display name or code of the school/college.

createdBy.description: UID of the coordinator who initialized the school tenant.

Classroom.title: Classroom
Classroom.description: School-scoped classroom workspace supporting real-time attendance sync between Coordinators and Representatives.

name.description: Classroom display name (e.g., CS-301 Batch A).

joinCode.description: Shareable alphanumeric code allowing a Class Representative from the same school to join.

ownerId.description: UID of the primary Class Coordinator who created the classroom.

coordinatorIds.description: Bounded list of Coordinator UIDs with full student roster and subject management permissions.

memberIds.description: Bounded list of all authorized member UIDs (Coordinators + Representatives) belonging to this school.

subjects.description: List of course subjects for attendance marking.

ClassroomInvite.title: ClassroomInvite
ClassroomInvite.description: School-scoped lookup index mapping a classroom joinCode to its classroomId.

classroomName.description: Display name of the target classroom.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Student record belonging to a school's classroom roster, imported from Excel/CSV or added manually.

createdBy.description: UID of the Coordinator who added the record.

memberIds.description: Denormalized member UIDs from parent classroom for rule-enforced list queries.

AttendanceSession.title: AttendanceSession
AttendanceSession.description: Lecture attendance session scoped under a school and classroom, storing Present (P) and Absent (A) status per student ID.

markedBy.description: UID of the user who last marked attendance.

markedByName.description: Display name of the user who last marked attendance.

records.description: Map of studentId to attendance status ('P' or 'A').

memberIds.description: Denormalized member UIDs from parent classroom for rule-enforced list queries.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile binding user to a single school tenant, active classroom, and role metadata.

/schools/{schoolId}.description: Institution root documents isolating multi-school tenants.

/schools/{schoolId}/invites/{joinCode}.description: School-scoped invite lookup documents keyed by classroom join code.

/schools/{schoolId}/classrooms/{classroo.description: School-scoped classroom workspaces shared between Coordinators and Representatives.
School- and classroom-scoped student roster managed by Coordinators.
School- and classroom-scoped real-time lecture attendance records.
